title: Mean, median and mode
goal: I can find the mean, median and mode of a data set.
teach: Mean: add all the values and divide by how many there are. Median: the middle value once the data is in order (the average of the two middle values if n is even). Mode: the value that occurs most often.

ex.q: Find the mean, median and mode of 5, 8, 3, 8, 6, 10, 9.
steps: In order: 3, 5, 6, 8, 8, 9, 10; the median is the 4th value, 8.

watch: Put the data in order before finding the median.

qs.steps:
1. Rule (median): write the data in order; the median is the middle value. For an even number of values, it is the mean of the two middle values.
2. In order: 7, 9, 10, 12, 15
3. The middle value is 10

1. Rule (median): write the data in order; the median is the middle value. For an even number of values, it is the mean of the two middle values.
2. In order: 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, 12
3. Median = (6 + 8) ÷ 2 = 7

1. Rule (mode): the value that occurs most often.
2. 7 occurs three times
3. Mode = 7
